tours.hint-auto-cancel-below-minimum: If a departure hasn't reached the minimum participants when the decision window arrives, it is cancelled automatically and tourists are notified. When off, staff see the departure in the panel and decide whether to confirm or cancel it.

tours.warn-charge-lead-hours: With fewer than {hours} hours, a declined card leaves no time to retry the charge: the departure is resolved on a single attempt.
